_the_decision_lives_here: provenance marker on arc_decompose rules documenting graph-native decision ownership
_never_parsed: provenance marker on arc_goals rules documenting unparsed testimony conditioning
effective_outcome_provenance: provenance tag recording the source of an effective capability outcome in capability_collapse
explanation: terminal human-readable explanation attribute on derived model-engineering mechanisms
motor_option_value_provenance: provenance tag on exposed motor decision options
needs_decomposition (Fault attr): acted on by repair_rung field flip + clause_synthesis re-arm; no separate consumer
obs_established: redundant witness of obs_unassessable (obs_established == 1 - obs_unassessable in learning_aperture_gate)
proof_kind: terminal witness classification on contextual model edit proofs
provenance_kind: terminal provenance tag indicating whether a node is perceived, imagined, or derived
terminal_reason: terminal status explanation written on closed or cancelled cognitive states
accepted_at_relaxed: provenance; read by evaluation and audit
accepted_rung: provenance; read by evaluation and audit
superseded_by_extended_thinking: provenance; read by evaluation and audit
assembled_from_seal: TemporalSequenceWindow lineage to its explicit input seal; retained for event-window provenance audit
candidate_kind: typed candidate origin label separating model branches from funded refinements in evaluation reports
event_ids: ordered measured-event provenance retained with each assembled temporal window for audit
funded_by_refinement_request: lineage edge proving that a new manifold projection version followed a funded request
parent_projection_version: audit field linking a refined candidate to the exact projection version it supersedes
projection_information_loss: native projector audit metric retained for P4 projection reports
projection_loss: native projector audit metric retained for P4 projection reports
projection_retained_width: native projector audit metric retained for P4 projection reports
projection_shape: full native projector shape snapshot retained for residual and topology audit
projection_support: native projector support result retained for P4 projection reports
projects_predicted_state: lineage edge from each manifold candidate to the exact imagined GWM state it audits
refined_from_candidate: lineage edge from a funded refinement result to its parent candidate
request_key: stable model, transition and projection identity retained on the one-shot funded refinement request for audit
requester_key: window identity retained on the funded temporal request for duplicate-charge audit
temporal_bridge: provenance marker distinguishing the separate motion_seq Observation created from measured temporal frames
temporal_source_window: lineage edge from TimeInfer's motion Observation to its measured source window
timestamps: ordered measured timestamps retained with each assembled window for cadence and provenance audit
ThoughtManifoldStep: terminal segment trace with candidate-imagery provenance; consumed by P4 trajectory reporting and never grounds a reading
has_thought_manifold_step: lineage edge read by the regulated thought adapter to return the graph-owned segment trace
ingests_thought_segment: lineage edge read by the regulated thought adapter to verify each graph trace against its source segment
CognitionManifoldFeasibilityReceipt: P4 evaluation evidence node; the frozen runner follows its candidate, transition and episode links and validates identity, version, horizon and projection fields before scoring.
ShapeOutcomeEvidence: Verified or negative Shape outcome record; retained as source evidence for signature epoch refresh and exact recall receipt minting.
ThoughtProjectedSignatureCoordinate: Native Observer-aperture coordinate linked to its raw source and topic signature; consumed by ThoughtManifold set-point/frontier projection.
deviation: ThoughtManifoldStep decision readout returned by the regulated thought adapter and retained for trajectory comparison.
frontier_candidates: ThoughtManifoldStep audit snapshot of the candidate set from which the native graph selected next_topic.
has_aperture_projection: Lineage edge retaining the raw ThoughtManifold coordinate used to produce an Observer-aperture projection.
next_width: ThoughtManifoldStep audit value recording the graph-owned width decision for the next segment.
projects_aperture_source: Lineage edge from a projected aperture dimension to its typed source descriptor, retained for provenance and epoch audits.
projects_query_source: Lineage edge from a recall query to its observed signature source, retained for scope and epoch audits.
projects_signature_source: Lineage edge from a typed signature descriptor to its source record, retained for provenance and epoch audits.
segment_stop: ThoughtManifoldStep stop reason read by the regulated thought adapter and retained in the public trajectory result.
verified_record_key: Exact recall settlement readout identifying the record accepted only after a matching verifier receipt.
verified_signature: Exact recall settlement lineage to the signature accepted only after receipt validation.
verifier_evidence_id: Identifier of the verified Shape outcome that backs the exact recall receipt.
verifier_kind: Typed verifier classification carried by feasibility and signature-verification receipts for evaluator validation.
verifies_candidate: Receipt lineage followed by the P4 evaluator to bind a native projection receipt to its candidate.
verifies_transition: Receipt lineage followed by the P4 evaluator to bind a native projection receipt to its model transition.
hands_off_to_episode: Lineage edge from a failed or stale recall result to the existing funded ExtendedThinkingEpisode that receives fallback; retained for adapter trace and audit.
scm_reason: Detached SCM stale-request abstention diagnostic returned on ScmQuery; caller readout only, never an observation or decision input.
scm_result: Detached finite-SCM result returned on ScmQuery for caller readout; never promoted to world evidence or used as an action decision.
model_hash_used: Detached SCM source-model hash copied to ScmQuery for caller provenance readout only; not an observation or decision input.
evaluated_source_epoch: Detached SCM model epoch copied to ScmQuery for caller provenance readout only; not an observation or decision input.
